_about: 351 Watch New York pilot: agenda platform and crawlable listing per tracked board, or the precise reason a town is not automated. Same per-town schema as towns_ma_all.json plus state, agenda_platform and why the town was chosen (selection_reason / selection_source_url). Built by `python3 experiments/ny_pilot.py discover` (watch351.discover_census with NY board names) and hand curation (CURATED in experiments/ny_pilot.py). Listings with "platform": "generic_ny" or "escribe" use the adapters added for this pilot. Wave 1 promotion (2026-11-02): 22 places moved in from data/test/wave1/config/towns_ny.json by `python3 experiments/wave2_test.py promote --wave 1`. Follow-up promotion (2026-11-03): Lansing, Southampton and Pound Ridge, plus the Wayne County and Schoharie County planning boards, from data/test/ny_followup/config/towns_ny.json (experiments/ny_followup.py); the document crawl-delay cap rose to 20 s the same day. Wave 2 promotion (2026-11-03): 26 places moved in from data/test/wave2/config/towns_ny.json by `python3 experiments/wave2_test.py promote --wave 2`; county rows (kind county, attribute_townships, county_body) are county planning boards read for GML 239-m referrals, and places with coverage via_county are read only through them. Wave 2 promotion (2026-11-03): 26 towns by `promote --wave 2`, plus the six county planning boards read in the county run (Allegany, Chemung, Greene, Lewis, Livingston, Orleans) by hand.
evidence_rule: discovery: board automated only if its listing shows >=1 agenda dated in [today-120d, today+120d]; curated listings were checked by hand
